objective: LungVision AI — Phase 5B 3D Lung Reconstruction Accuracy Optimization and Anatomical Validation.
acceptance_criteria: Gate A: Forensic SSM Validation & PCA Spectrum Audit (Audit fit_multi_patient_ssm.py, verified_multi_patient_manifest.json, ssm_lung_pca_v2.json; investigate the 100.0% variance claim; compute full eigenvalue spectrum, condition number, effective rank, and reconstruction errors for 1, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20 modes into phase5b_ssm_spectrum_audit.json).

Gate B: Baseline Comparison & Oracle Upper Bound (Evaluate Mean SSM, Frontal-only, Lateral-only, Dual-concat, Dual-attention, and Oracle CT-projected coefficients on identical 65 held-out test patients; export phase5b_baseline_comparison.json and phase5b_oracle_upper_bound.json).

Gate C: Improved Shape Prediction & Model Ablation (Investigate heteroscedastic coefficient prediction with uncertainty log-variance, multi-task left/right shape heads, and enhanced cross-attention; verify anatomical plausibility and Mahalanobis limits; export phase5b_model_ablation.json and new model checkpoint).

Gate D: Mesh Surface Quality & Correspondence Regularization (Evaluate Laplacian/Taubin surface smoothing, normal consistency, non-self-intersection, and left/right boundary preservation on held-out reference surfaces; export phase5b_surface_quality_metrics.json).

Gate E: Bilateral Volumetry Audit (Verify divergence theorem volume calculation, units mm3->mL, mesh closure, signed orientation, left/right separation, and comparison against ground-truth CT mask volume; export phase5b_volumetry_audit.json).

Gate F: Rigorous Statistical Validation (Patient-level paired evaluation with ASSD, HD95, Dice at 1/2/3/5mm, Volumetric Error; audit Wilcoxon W=0, ties/non-zero pairs, exact vs asymptotic p-values, Holm-Bonferroni correction, and effect sizes into phase5b_statistical_validation.json).

Gate G: Multi-Condition Robustness Assessment (Evaluate PA vs AP, rotation, translation/crop, exposure variations, resolutions, and missing lateral view fallback; export phase5b_robustness_report.json).

Gate H: Frontend Visualization Enhancement (Update DualViewXRayPage and SSM3DReconstructionViewer with side-by-side predicted vs reference CT, error heatmap vertex coloring, uncertainty visualization, and responsive controls).

Gate I: Automated Test Suite & Authoritative Report (Add comprehensive backend and frontend tests verifying all Phase 5B capabilities while preserving production invariants, and publish PHASE_5B_RECONSTRUCTION_IMPROVEMENT_REPORT.md).
non_goals: Do not modify or retrain frozen DenseNet121 weights (8d3690cd...)
Do not alter frozen NIH production classification thresholds
Do not overwrite existing Phase 5 checkpoints (dual_view_shape_predictor_best.pth) or PCA artifact v2
Do not use CT spacing, dimensions, or mask metadata as predictor inputs (prevent shortcut learning)
Never display predicted 3D mesh as an actual CT scan or make unsupported clinical diagnostic claims
